implementation_notes: Landmark bbox order is[x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max]. Exact identified stair vectors and registration points have high confidence; wide building bounds and room boxes are approximate where explicitly marked or visually inferred.
Most side wings and administration walls use linewidth0.72 or0.36, not1.08. A1.08-only extraction omits major buildings.
Walls are partly polylines in pdfplumber.curves rather than pdfplumber.lines. Long building outlines cannot be recovered from line records alone.
Emergency extinguisher/CO2/ABC/Pó/fire signage and flower-like emergency-light symbols are annotations, not furniture to instantiate as room obstacles.

BLOCO A AMPLIAR is planned expansion, not proof that a physical building exists today. It can be included as the user's desired plan-based reference, but label it appropriately in map-generation docs.

The source contains only implantation plans, not elevations, sections or final-model specifications. Interior height, stair riser count, accessible roof connections and decorative furnishing are implementation choices and must not be falsely attributed to the PDF.
